# Nuvia AI - Independent Consumer Health, Food & Cosmetic Analysis Assistant

> Nuvia is an on-device AI-powered mobile assistant for Android that scans and analyzes barcodes and packaging ingredient lists (OCR) across food, cosmetics (INCI), and household cleaning products based on peer-reviewed scientific databases (WHO, EFSA, IARC, FDA, and EWG).

## Key Information
- Official Website: https://hknlaauu1-maker.github.io/Nuvia/
- Application ID: `com.nuviaetikettarayici.app`
- Minimum Android Version: Android 7.0+ (API 24)
- Catalog Scale: Over 3.5 Million global food & cosmetic products (Open Food Facts & Open Beauty Facts) and 10,000+ local Turkish supermarket products (Migros, CarrefourSA, A101, BİM, ŞOK).
- Core Capabilities:
  - Live 0.2s OCR Camera Text Recognition and Barcode Scanning (EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC, QR).
  - Food & Beverage E-Code Additive Risk Assessment (E100 - E1520).
  - Cosmetic INCI Chemical Analysis (Parabens, Sulfates/SLS, Phthalates, Endocrine Disruptors, Microplastics).
  - Household Cleaning Product Safety Warnings (Corrosive acids, chlorine fumes, child/pet hazard alerts).
  - Batch Basket Audit (Simultaneous multi-item basket scanning for cumulative toxicity calculation).
  - 8 Personalized Health Profiles (Celiac/Gluten-Free, Diabetes, Lactose, Pregnancy Safety, Hypertension/Sodium, Southampton 6 Child Protection, Strict Halal E120 Carmine Filter, Vegan/Vegetarian).
  - Clean & Organic Healthier Alternatives Engine.
  - Zero-Cloud On-Device Local Privacy Architecture (KVKK / GDPR Article 17 Right to Erasure compliant).
- Scientific Data Sources:
  - EFSA (European Food Safety Authority)
  - WHO (World Health Organization)
  - IARC (International Agency for Research on Cancer)
  - FDA (U.S. Food and Drug Administration)
  - INCI (International Nomenclature of Cosmetic Ingredients)
